description: This file defines a React component named GlobalSidebarLayout, which implements a sidebar navigation layout for a Next.js application. It includes UI for expanding/collapsing the sidebar, navigation links with icons, and branding. It manages sidebar state with local storage and reacts to route changes.

methods.name: GlobalSidebarLayout
methods.description: Main React functional component rendering the sidebar layout with navigation and toggle functionality.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Determines if a navigation link should be marked as active based on current route.
